2026_04_NE_BUF.headline: Buffalo’s offense attacks a Patriots defense missing Gonzalez and Barmore
2026_04_NE_BUF.paragraph1: New England heads to Buffalo without cornerback Christian Gonzalez and defensive tackle Christian Barmore, removing two major pieces from Mike Vrabel’s defense against Josh Allen and an unbeaten Bills offense. Drake Maye is cleared despite a shoulder issue, but the Patriots still need cleaner protection and ball security after a difficult start. Buffalo has its own secondary question with Christian Benford questionable, yet James Cook and Allen give Joe Brady multiple ways to force New England’s depleted defense to defend the entire field.
2026_04_NE_BUF.model_rationale: New England’s defensive absences increase the strain of containing Buffalo’s balanced offense, while the Patriots need Maye to sustain possessions and avoid giving the Bills short fields.
